topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I planted that tree with my own two hands, a sapling so small, barely a sprout. Years went by, each one marking its growth, a silent witness to my life, my joys, my sorrows. It stood there, a sturdy sentinel in the yard, until one day it didn’t. Just gone. Vanished, like it never mattered. Like the time and care and love I gave meant nothing. They cut it down, those careless hands, and with it, a piece of my history. Now there’s just an empty space, a stark reminder of what was lost. There’s no replacing that. No new tree can fill the gap it leaves behind.
